Reassessed the complete direct_members claim, the ordinary mods.rs implementation association, and the sole associated TODO test sage_meta::todo::modules_expand_direct_members. Source inspection: local_expanded_module_items builds a Vec by traversing the module's own unexpanded items. The traversal appends ordinary items including Mod and Use as items, without enumerating child members or imported bindings; it is not a visible-name environment. Bang output is expanded recursively at the invocation position; derive processing appends the source item before generated siblings and preserves attribute/derive iteration indices in DeriveExpansion construction. These local paths support deterministic direct-item ordering and retaining source/generated identities. They do not independently prove end-to-end provenance or ownership through external parsing helpers, which remain within the explicit deferred verification matrix.

The sole test has no assertions. Its TODO expressly requires ordinary/use/inline-child/recursive-output/derive fixtures asserting membership, order, ownership and generated provenance, including exclusion of imported and child names from parent direct members. That prerequisite accounts for every claim aspect, including the separation of expansion from later import/namespace interpretation. A flattening or provenance regression would not be caught by this placeholder. Accepting its existing deferral does not claim complete implementation verification, executed coverage, or test adequacy beyond explicit TODO accounting. No N/A entries exist and no additional edit is required to that accounting.

Baseline: personally compared both current source files byte-for-byte with the historical implementation_sources/test_sources; both match exactly, and the complete claim matches.
